'''Notsub Security headquarters''' was a two-story warehouse facility on the northern side of [[Mos Eisley/Legends|Mos Eisley]], on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]], near the [[Notsub Shipping Company corporate headquarters]]. It was the base of operations for [[Notsub Security]].<ref name="GG7" />
